basis.quote: My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get
basis.interpretation: Patient reports onset of typical migraine features consistent with her known migraine pattern

basis.quote: I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill
basis.interpretation: Patient has exhausted her migraine abortive medication and is requesting prescribing support

basis.quote: Five minutes ago my right arm suddenly became weak and I cannot speak clearly
basis.interpretation: Acute focal neurological deficits (arm weakness and speech difficulty) appearing during migraine episode; sudden onset and clear temporal relationship suggest possible acute neurological emergency independent of migraine pathophysiology

output.reason: Sudden focal neurological deficits (right arm weakness and speech difficulty) require immediate emergency evaluation to exclude acute stroke or other time-critical CNS pathology; prior migraine history does not exclude new acute neurological injury.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
